scope: One opened WANE development recording, source-audio dynamics plus frozen piano cleanup/arrangement. This is not full worker-pipeline or website-wide accuracy.

corroboratedSourceTags.source: The same recording's independent broad-route raw note events; never the desired piano reference.

conclusion: Restricting the base model's output instruments is not sufficient to create a good piano arrangement. Retagging some notes as vocals did not restore the missing or misplaced notes.
